changes: New panels now start on the cluster API: the installer switches it on, new load balancers join in mode 2 when possible, and MAIN's data plane is switched on.

Deprecated the old load-balancer link (a load balancer not enrolled in the cluster API, its /api with the stream password, and its access to MAIN's database and Redis); it will be removed in a later major release.
Redesigned the Cluster Nodes page in the Manage Servers format, with a searchable table, a row actions menu and a Legacy /api calls column that shows what still uses each load balancer's old /api.
Proxies no longer keep the load balancers' legacy /api open, and the legacy /api no longer sends a CORS header.
Added rolling load-balancer updates, a guided cutover to mode 1, moving a node to mode 2 from the page, an optional automatic mode down, and new load balancers joining directly in mode 2.
Added RTMP viewers on load balancers with their line checked by MAIN, mode 2 with the Redis connection handler, and Viewer Record Proof with a readiness card.
Added a fleet canary for the binaries every server takes from GitHub, a release pin, and a switch for MAIN's data plane on the Cluster Nodes page.
Firewall blocks now live in ipset sets, installed on new servers and on update; large blocklists sync in parts.
Added cluster alerts and /metrics for Prometheus with a /healthz endpoint.
Added two-factor sign-in for admins and resellers.
Replaced the single API key with named, scoped API tokens.
Added an audit log of what admins change.
Added a maintenance mode that closes the client APIs and reseller access.
Added alerts and expiry reminders by Telegram, webhook and e-mail.
Added off-site backup copies, a sealed recovery bundle and restore tests; the live database is dumped before a restore and before an update.
The dashboard now checks every server, adds disk, backup, certificate and cache rows, and warns when a server's clock is off MAIN's; servers wait for NTP's first synchronisation at boot.
Rewrote the Modules page around module status and the official store, with module actions run as background jobs.
Exposed the custom ffmpeg command in the stream form, made the Instant Off grace period configurable, and read subtitles from shared mounts.
Improved EPG, log, cache and playlist performance with one-pass deduplication, batched retention, new indexes and broader playlist caching.
Blocked addresses that try many passwords for one username, counted refused sign-ins on every client entry point, and hardened session cookies.
Enforced the right permission on every admin page, action, table and admin API call, and kept resellers to their own tree, packages and trials with atomic credits stored as DECIMAL(16,4).
Kept both web players to the line's own content with a session cookie of their own, and restricted the image resizer to public addresses.
Ministra: a MAG device is served only once the portal has verified it, the Stalker API answers at /server/load.php, and handshake and field formats were fixed.
The installer verifies its downloads and validates certificate host names; updates report a failed migration.
Fixed record edits so fields an edit leaves out are kept, and fixed dates shown in the panel timezone.
Fixed hanging cron:servers and cron:streams runs, cron locks, and stream starts from stored values with complete source cookies.
